# 金光明經玄義科

**ID:** X0355
**Volume:** X20
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 明 明得排定
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0355

## Contributors
- 明得 (A008323)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X355 is a one-fascicle *kē* 科 (topical outline / structural divisions) of *[Jīnguāngmíng xuányì 金光明玄義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304)* (T1783) — that is, a tabular skeleton of Zhìyǐ's commentary, organising its argument under nested rubrics. The genre serves as a study aid: each major and sub-division of the parent text is laid out as a hierarchical bullet-list. The compiler is identified in the Taishō witness as 雙徑沙門明得排定, "[明得](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E5%BE%97) of Mt Shuāngjìng (= Jīngshān 徑山), arranged".

**Abstract**

The work is one of [明得](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E5%BE%97)'s four ancillary Tiāntái treatises on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* corpus, prepared together with [KR6i0312](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0312) (*Wénjù kē* on T1785) and the two *huìběn* collations [KR6i0311](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0311) and [KR6i0313](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0313). The four are explicitly listed in 明得's DILA biography (A008323) and are paired with his three-year retreat at Língxiāo Peak on Mt Jīngshān and subsequent lecturing at the Chuányīān; the most defensible date bracket follows his mature Tiāntái productive period (c. 1560–1588). The treatise is essentially diagrammatic and adds little doctrinal content of its own, but is invaluable as a finding-aid for [T1783](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304) and as documentation of late-Míng Tiāntái pedagogical practice.

Related canonical texts: parent commentary [KR6i0304](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0304) (金光明經玄義 / T1783); paired *kē* [KR6i0312](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0312) (金光明經文句科 / X357).
